summary: Iter90 — RBAC audit trail + Quick-Grant dialog on /admin/access. Backend 3/3 pytest green: GET /api/admin/access/role-audit returns {entries, count} with proper shape and diff arrays; PATCHing admin_finance to add labels.bank.verify surfaces newest audit entry role_name='Admin Finance' with added containing labels.bank.verify; no-op PATCH does NOT increment count; admin_finance permissions restored to ORIGINAL set (verified via GET). Quick-grant underlying flow: created TEMP custom role (perms=['dashboard.view']), PATCHed with union+['analytics.view'] → 200, listed role includes analytics.view, temp role DELETED (200) — cleanup verified. Frontend as Super Admin on /admin/access: admin-role-audit-panel renders with 93 entries, 85 diff blocks, admin-role-audit-refresh reload works. Konfigurasi diperlukan banner (admin-perm-review-banner) visible for 1 pending perm (Verifikasi Rekening / labels.bank.verify) with Berikan ke role… button (admin-perm-review-grant); clicking opens quick-grant-dialog with quick-grant-role-select and quick-grant-submit present; cancel closes cleanly. Permission search (admin-permission-search) still renders; no JS console errors on the page.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_access.py:_perm_label uses PERMISSION_NAMES.get(key, (key, key))[0] — safe fallback but silent when a permission has been removed from catalog. Acceptable given audit is historical.
role-audit endpoint noise-filter skips update_admin_role only when added/removed/name/active are all unchanged. Description-only edits are correctly ignored per test observation.
seed_data_creation: Temporary role TEST_QuickGrant_Iter90 created and deleted in same test. admin_finance permissions momentarily patched with labels.bank.verify then restored to original set (verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two new /admin/access features fully green: RoleAuditPanel (data-testid admin-role-audit-panel/-entry/-diff/-refresh) and QuickGrantDialog (opened via admin-perm-review-grant inside admin-perm-review-banner when review.count>0). Login uses access_token key (not 'token') in /api/auth/login response. Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter90_role_audit_quick_grant.py.
